facts.title: near hit during cleaning and preparation on PSV-8210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-8210 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-8210 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 8 February 2006 a near hit was recorded on PSV-8210 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during cleaning and preparation; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
